profile.reading: Per Aureon own site, the company describes itself as a wholesale network connectivity and infrastructure provider with over 60,000 miles of fiber, and references data center connectivity and data center solutions as services it offers to other organizations. The only physical addresses published on the homepage are corporate offices in West Des Moines, Iowa and Overland Park, Kansas; no data center facility street address, square footage, or power capacity is disclosed for a Des Moines area facility. This registry record is flagged here for a future review of the operator attribution rather than corrected unilaterally, since the fetched page describes Aureon primarily as a connectivity and managed services provider rather than a disclosed data center facility owner.
